author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.54 shipped: Running-fan release ignores radar motion bits; house state unknown (not away) at boot
summary: Running-fan release ignores radar motion bits; house state unknown (not away) at boot
why: The running-fan release waited for motion to go stale, but a Meross radar's motion bit in the motion list kept refreshing that clock while the fan ran, so the release never fired in Guest Bedroom 1, Guest Bedroom 2 and Media; only fan-immune witnesses now stamp it, while the stale-occupancy failsafe keeps the old freshness so sleeping-body protection is unchanged. House-state sensors showed away for a moment at every restart, which read as a real Away transition in history; they now report unknown until the manager is up.
implications: Shipped D2-PIR-STAMP-FOLLOWS-FAN-IMMUNE-WITNESS-1, HOUSE-STATE-SENSOR-BOOT-AWAY-DISPLAY-1 at v5.103.54; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.54.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If a GB1/GB2/Media room releases while someone is present, or house state shows away across a restart.
